text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yukino! Yukino! Snow falling soft and 
silent♪ ... ......

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: "...Huh? I'm not doing it, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Chowaa?! Please wait! We can't start the 
"Sing and Dance Fun! Surprise Birthday" 
like this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawa-?! Bakushin O-san, you're 
spoiling the surprise...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
EEEEEEEEEEH~?!?!?!? ...Uh, um, what should 
I doooo!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... You two are hilarious. Sure, why 
not, this is actually getting pretty 
fun...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Tell me what you were planning to do. 
Since you went through the trouble, I 
might as well accept it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank ya kindly! Bakushin O-san came up 
with an "avant-garde" idea that I'd never 
have thought of myself!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply! A high-speed canon 
round! Chasing after singing voices that 
get faster and faster... Until finally, 
weâbecome one with Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I see. Hmm... Nah, never mind.
